periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of each patch is oriented obliquely, sloping downwards and outwards from the medial supraorbital region towards the lateral zygomatic region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.6:1, exhibiting vertical elongation.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering creating a pyriform or teardrop shape where the lowest margin extends significantly below the horizontal midline of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior margin of the band displays a broad, shallow U-shaped profile across the thoracic-lumbar transition.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band maintains a consistent, heavy thickness across the lateral flanks, covering approximately one-quarter of the visible longitudinal torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement with a clear white cranial gap between the medial bases of the pinnae.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and smooth semicircular curvature at the superior apex of each ear.
